messages:
laura: Quick sync on the live event logistics for next Thurs. Need owners for: registration copy + consent flags, Zoom recording settings, and same-day clip/email send.

neil: I can do the reg page and privacy bits. Minimal required fields: name, email, company, region, consent checkbox for marketing. I'll add a hidden utm_source field for partners.

priya: I'll own Zoom and recordings. Set cloud recording, enable transcript (en-US), export .srt, and configure RTMP fallback. Also add alternative hosts for recording.

laura: Great. For clips we want: promo highlight (0-2m), benchmark slice (2-6m), demo CTA (6-10m). Can we commit to same-day 3 clips in Drive?

neil: Yes—I'll rough-cut and drop timestamps within 12hrs. ops-bot, please create folder and share.

ops-bot: Folder created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1exampleShare — shared with marketing@example.com, sales@example.com :white_check_mark:

priya: HubSpot mapping: form -> contact fields + tag leads with webinar:launch and utm_campaign. Region routing: APAC->apac-sales, EMEA->emea-sales, else na-sales. Also export consent CSV to S3/legal post-event.

hubspot-bot: Noted. Will map fields and push consent exports to s3://redwood-legal/consents/webinar-2076543210.csv after event.

laura: Email cadence: same-day replay + clips, 48h CTA to trial, 2-week webinar deep-dive invite. Priya will draft the 48h CTA; Neil drafts same-day.

neil: Confirmed. Also adding UTM: utm_campaign=rdw-launch-23 and utm_medium=email_social.

priya: Dry-run scheduled Wed 10:00 PT to validate recording + SRT pipeline. Ops-bot will post invites.

ops-bot: Dry-run invite posted for Wed 10:00 PT. Reminder set for Tue to validate captions. :bell:

laura: Perfect. Action items: neil=reg page + clips; priya=zoom + srt pipeline; ops-bot=drive + dry-run. Reopen after rehearsal. :white_check_mark:
